scope: Unified capabilities/serves/materials core; existing lifecycle implementation; passive package and compatibility import boundaries
verified: Passive-only materials declaration with SKILL.md seals without executable bindings. After editing original SKILL.md, retrieved artifact still contains the originally sealed bytes. No callable entries are generated.
Canonical capabilities map retains both echo and engine; callable_entries selects echo, service_entries selects engine. Normalization is idempotent.
Previous applications draft imports into canonical serves exactly, removes the old applications field, and a conflicting capability/application name rejects DUPLICATE_ID.

Served capability dispatch remains explicitly lifecycle-based; material retrieval does not invent a runnable tool or execute a skill. MCP listing uses callable_entries rather than fabricating a generic engine invocation.
